steps.description: Release earned fees to the vault
Process membership inventory before donations within the approved budget

quote.note: Single batch quote, not an aggregate backlog projection. Execution drag combines trading fees and price impact. Rehearse for sequential market effects.

warnings: Policy replacement grants a fresh finite budget; this is not a rolling daily allowance.
Permissionless callers may execute eligible batches in a different order or sooner than this projection.
Current contracts do not invalidate this policy if the launch graduates after submission.
Sampled prices cannot guarantee fair value or prevent sustained manipulation.

rehearsal.summary: Selected backlog processed within the reviewed policy
rehearsal.authorization: Impersonated Safe on disposable child only; not proof of owner signatures or Safe execution gas
assumptions: One second of child chain time per rehearsal transaction
Child funds and relaxed gas/code limits are simulation allowances, not public execution guarantees

feeEstimate.note: Measured child gas multiplied by the source RPC gas price at rehearsal start. Local-fork gas price is not a public-network fee estimate. Excludes Safe signature/execution overhead and any additional chain-specific fees; actual fees may change.
